evidence_to_use.evidence_text: Survey data shows crypto ownership is high, while security concerns and volatility continue to limit broader adoption.
evidence_to_use.role_in_post: Use as adoption evidence qualified by limits.

post_brief.practical_point: Permit bounded metaphor while blocking invented content.
post_brief.ending_direction: End on the distinction between signal and verdict.
post_brief.cta_direction: Ask readers to separate rhetoric from new factual claims.

angle_decision.controlling_angle: Metaphor is allowed when it stays bounded by evidence.

angle_decision.author_position: The author treats adoption as signal, not verdict.
angle_decision.main_tension: Distinctive phrasing versus unsupported new fact.

cases.rhetorical_intent: combine sources without inventing outcome proof

evidence.evidence_text: One education technology report shows high classroom usage of an AI tutoring tool.
evidence.role_in_post: Use as usage evidence.

evidence.evidence_text: A separate study says learning outcomes were not measured and warns that adoption data should not be read as proof of educational impact.
evidence.role_in_post: Use as outcome-limitation evidence.

cases.candidate_post: One source shows usage. Another shows structural limits. Put together, they argue against reading usage as impact.

post_brief.opening_direction: Open with the tension between usage and outcomes.
post_brief.pattern_interrupt: Usage evidence is not impact evidence.
post_brief.core_point: High usage and missing outcome measurement should be synthesized without claiming improvement.

evidence_to_use.evidence_text: One education technology report shows high classroom usage of an AI tutoring tool.
evidence_to_use.role_in_post: Use as usage evidence.

evidence_to_use.evidence_text: A separate study says learning outcomes were not measured and warns that adoption data should not be read as proof of educational impact.
evidence_to_use.role_in_post: Use as outcome-limitation evidence.

post_brief.practical_point: Do not confuse reach with learning.
post_brief.ending_direction: End with usage not equaling impact.
post_brief.cta_direction: Ask readers what the evidence actually measured.

angle_decision.controlling_angle: Usage evidence should not be inflated into learning-outcome evidence.
angle_decision.reader_problem: Readers may treat adoption data as proof of impact.
angle_decision.author_position: The author synthesizes usage and limits without inventing improvement.
